entities.name: Clotilde Luisi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Clotilde Luisi was the first female lawyer in Uruguay. She was also a professor, pedagogue, translator, feminist activist, and the first Uruguayan woman to study at the Faculty of Law of the University of the Republic.
